videos.scope: 本課「晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測」的延伸背景。以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Wafer thin-film ellipsometry. Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
videos.before: 先問：「p/s 偏振：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence p/s polarization: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「色散模型：建立模型」列為查證任務：透明模型不能無條件延伸到吸收能帶；色散模型需檢查物理一致性。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Dispersion model: construct and analyze: Transparent models cannot be extended blindly into absorption; Dispersion models require physical-consistency checks.

courses.overview: 從「晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測」延伸比較光學散射量測、高介電常數原子層沉積：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer thin-film ellipsometry by comparing Optical scatterometry and High-k atomic layer deposition: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: 兩者都把光學訊號配合物理模型反推出結構，必須處理 n、k、幾何耦合及不唯一性。
related.transferEn: Both infer structures from optical signals and physical models, requiring treatment of n/k, geometry coupling and nonuniqueness.
related.difference: 散射量測常針對週期圖形；薄膜橢偏常用層狀堆疊。不能把平面膜厚模型直接套用有側壁的光柵。
related.differenceEn: Scatterometry commonly targets periodic features; film ellipsometry commonly uses layered stacks. A planar-film model cannot simply replace a grating model.
practice: 畫層狀膜與光柵的不同模型邊界。
改變一個 n 或幾何參數並比較敏感度。
以第二角度或獨立量測檢查退化解。
practiceEn: Draw different model boundaries for films and gratings.
Perturb one optical or geometric parameter and compare sensitivity.
Use another angle or independent metrology to test degenerate solutions.
related.title: 光學散射量測

related.whyEn: Both infer structures from optical signals and physical models, requiring treatment of n/k, geometry coupling and nonuniqueness.

related.transfer: ALD 成膜後可用橢偏追蹤膜厚與光學參數，建立成膜循環與量測結果的對應。
related.transferEn: After ALD, ellipsometry can track film thickness and optical parameters against deposition cycles.
related.difference: 橢偏是依模型反推，ALD 是表面反應製程；每循環成長率與超薄介面層不能只靠單波長自由擬合判定。
related.differenceEn: Ellipsometry is model-based inference; ALD is a surface-reaction process. Growth per cycle and ultrathin interfaces cannot be established from unrestricted single-wavelength fits.
practice: 比較不同循環數的假設厚度資料與截距。
在模型中加入可能的介面層。
用多角度與獨立標準檢查厚度可信區間。
practiceEn: Compare hypothetical thickness-versus-cycle data and intercepts.
Include a possible interface layer in the model.
Use multiple angles and independent standards to assess thickness intervals.

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從p/s 偏振、厚度與 n到報告與限制：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From p/s polarization and Thickness-index coupling to Report and limits: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
